# wallix.bastion.targetgroup

Manage target groups on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a target group on a WALLIX Bastion.
- A target group lists the accounts, devices and services that sessions and password retrieval can use; an authorization ([`wallix.bastion.authorization`](authorization.md)) grants a user group access to it.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_targetgroup` Terraform resource.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The group is looked up by [`group_name`](#parameter-group-name), so it cannot be renamed with this module.
- The accounts, devices, services and domains referenced must exist; the Bastion rejects the change otherwise.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Give access to the SSH service of a Linux server with a local and a global account
  wallix.bastion.targetgroup:
    group_name: linux-servers
    description: Linux servers
    session_accounts:
      - account: root
        domain: local
        domain_type: local
        device: srv-linux-01
        service: SSH
      - account: admin
        domain: corp.example.com
        domain_type: global
        device: srv-linux-01
        service: SSH
    session_interactive_logins:
      - device: srv-linux-01
        service: SSH
    password_retrieval_accounts:
      - account: root
        domain: local
        domain_type: local
        device: srv-linux-01
    restrictions:
      - action: kill
        rules: "rm -rf /"
        subprotocol: SSH_SHELL_SESSION

- name: Remove every interactive login of the group, keep the rest
  wallix.bastion.targetgroup:
    group_name: linux-servers
    session_interactive_logins: []

- name: Remove a target group
  wallix.bastion.targetgroup:
    group_name: linux-servers
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the group already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["session_accounts"]` |
| <a id="return-targetgroup"></a>**targetgroup** | `dict` | The target group after the change, with the session and password retrieval lists flattened as in the module options and their items reduced to the fields that are set.<br>In check mode, the expected group. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-targetgroup) |

<a id="sample-targetgroup"></a>

### Sample of `targetgroup`

```yaml
description: Linux servers
group_name: linux-servers
id: 1a0f6e96bbce3423005056b66c8b
password_retrieval_accounts:
- account: root
  device: srv-linux-01
  domain: local
  domain_type: local
restrictions:
- action: kill
  rules: rm -rf /
  subprotocol: SSH_SHELL_SESSION
session_account_mappings: []
session_accounts:
- account: root
  device: srv-linux-01
  domain: local
  domain_type: local
  service: SSH
session_interactive_logins:
- device: srv-linux-01
  service: SSH
session_scenario_accounts: []
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/targetgroups/1a0f6e96bbce3423005056b66c8b
```
